messages:
Tom Alvarez: FYI pricing experiment BetaDiscount didn't apply for some March invoices. Mateo found ~ $18.4k overcharged. Need rev impact and month-end fix.

Mateo Ruiz: Billing export: 6 invoices missed promo due to promo_flag=false. Backfill job failed. I computed deltas per invoice in sheet.

Nora Li: Sales Ops missed toggling historical subscriptions. We fixed new cycles but didn't backfill. Sorry.

Priya Kapoor: Were those invoices already recognized? If yes, we must reverse recognized revenue and issue credit memos. ASC 606 adjustment required.

BillingBot: Invoices INV-2025-03-88 and INV-2025-03-92 PAID 2025-03-05 and 2025-03-07.

Helen Park: Plan: issue credit memos, reverse recognized revenue for the portion already earned, adjust deferred schedule for remaining periods. Need customer consent for credit vs refund.

Mateo Ruiz: I'll generate credit memos and tag NetSuite with beta_reprice_adjust. One customer wants refund, rest want credits.

Victor Nguyen: I'll open ENG ticket to backfill promo_flag and add a nightly validation for 90 days. ENG-1129 created.

Priya Kapoor: Draft JE example (per-account):
2025-05-15 Debit Revenue $X
            Credit AR/Cash $X
And reduce Deferred Revenue for future periods by remaining delta.

Tom Alvarez: Action items: Mateo create memos; Priya prepare JEs; Nora collect customer dispositions; Victor run backfill. Deadline: post adjustments within 2 business days for month-end.

Helen Park: Approve pending uploaded worksheet, NetSuite screenshots, and customer confirmations.

Tom Alvarez: Thanks team. Track in month-end tracker under "BetaDiscount retro credits" and close when JEs + docs uploaded. :white_check_mark:
